title: Delta Code Solution
short: Full-stack marketplace with payments & admin panel
description: Delta Code Solutions delivers innovative digital solutions that drive business growth, efficiency, and success.
fullDescription: Delta Code Solutions is a leading software development company delivering scalable and reliable digital solutions. We focus on understanding clients’ unique needs and provide technology-driven strategies for growth. Our skilled team ensures high-quality delivery across web, mobile, and enterprise platforms.

title: Bone Fracture Detection System
short: Deep Learning Model for Bone Fracture Detection
description: Frontend React JS + Deep Learning backend model to detect bone fractures.
fullDescription: AI-powered medical imaging system using deep learning to detect bone fractures from X-ray images. Employs convolutional neural networks (CNNs) trained on thousands of images with high accuracy, featuring a user-friendly interface for medical professionals.

title: Portfolio Website
description: Modern personal portfolio to showcase projects, skills, and experience.
fullDescription: This portfolio highlights professional work as a full-stack developer. Features include a clean UI, dynamic project listings, smooth animations with Framer Motion, fully responsive design, and performance optimization using Next.js and Tailwind CSS.

title: EduManage
description: Simplify academic administration and performance tracking.
fullDescription: EduManage is a student management system to streamline administration. Allows managing student records, attendance, and marks. Built with React frontend and NestJS + MySQL backend, it provides fast, secure, and scalable operations with a clean and responsive UI.

title: Health Metrics Pro
description: Track BMI, ideal weight, and fitness progress.
fullDescription: Health Metrics Pro is a professional web app for health and wellness tracking. Users can calculate BMI, estimate ideal weight, and get instant health insights. Features a responsive design for smooth user experience on all devices.

title: Digital Marketing Campaign
description: Comprehensive digital marketing strategy and execution.
fullDescription: End-to-end digital marketing campaigns including SEO, social media marketing, content strategy, and analytics. Achieved significant growth in traffic and conversions through data-driven strategies.

title: WearHub
description: Discover outfits tailored to user preferences.
fullDescription: WearHub is an AI-based e-commerce platform providing personalized clothing recommendations. Users input height, weight, skin tone, and gender to receive AI-generated outfit suggestions. Built with Next.js, MongoDB, and TailwindCSS for a modern and responsive shopping experience.
